text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Happy birthday, Pearl! Hehe, the wait<n>is over!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, you mean it's party time?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When you kicked me out of the room<n>this morning, I
had a feeling a<n>surprise was coming.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ☆ Kawakami and I teamed up to<n>make lots
and lots of yummy food.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Cakes and tea, chanko with fried rice<n>and curry—the
table might splinter<n>under the feast we've
prepared!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, fabulous! You've outdoneyourselves—it all sounds so global!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is going to be one spectacular<n>day—no doubt
about it! Consider your<n>surprise a success!
